scripts.setup:browser: npm exec --offline --workspace Frontend -- playwright install chrome
scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces && npm run check:assets
scripts.build:ts: npm run build --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/packages/contracts" && npm run build --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/packages/housing-query" && npm run build --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/packages/mcp-core" && npm run build --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/packages/moving-service" && npm run build --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/platform-api" && npm run build --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/mcp-server" && npm run build --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/moving-api" && npm run build --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/moving-mcp-server"
scripts.build:moving: npm run build --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/packages/contracts" && npm run build --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/packages/mcp-core" && npm run build --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/packages/moving-service" && npm run build --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/moving-api" && npm run build --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/moving-mcp-server"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:python && npm run lint:ts
scripts.lint:python: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff check src/ tests/ scripts/deploy-coolify.py scripts/test-migration-image.py scripts/select-ci-images.py scripts/check-workspace-images.py
scripts.format:check: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format --check src/ tests/
scripts.format: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format src/ tests/
scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:ts && npm run test:contracts
scripts.test:python: node scripts/python.mjs -m pytest tests/ Frontend/tests/ "Maps VN/LifeFlow/demo/test_demo.py" -v --tb=short
scripts.test:ts: npm run test --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/packages/contracts" && npm run test --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/packages/mcp-core" && npm run test --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/packages/moving-service" && npm run test --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/moving-api" && npm run test --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/moving-mcp-server" && npm exec --offline --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/mcp-server" -- vitest run tests/mcp-http.integration.test.ts && npm exec --offline --workspace "Maps VN/LifeFlow/packages/housing-query" -- vitest run tests/environment-isolation.test.ts
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:ts && npm run test:contracts
scripts.test:contracts: npm exec --offline --workspace Frontend -- playwright test --config playwright.contracts.config.ts
scripts.test:browser: npm exec --offline --workspace Frontend -- playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --workers=2
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.deployment:check: node scripts/python.mjs -m pytest tests/test_coolify_deployment.py tests/test_deployment_settings.py tests/test_ci_images.py tests/test_web_image_layout.py -q
scripts.dev:agent: node scripts/dev.mjs api -- python -m uvicorn src.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.dev:gateway: node scripts/dev.mjs ui -- python -m uvicorn Frontend.server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8503 --workers 1
scripts.dev:flight-demo: node scripts/dev.mjs flight-demo -- python -m streamlit run src/ui/flight_demo.py
scripts.dev:payment-demo: node scripts/dev.mjs payment-demo -- python -m streamlit run src/ui/payment_demo.py --server.port 8502
scripts.dev:agent-chat: node scripts/dev.mjs api -- python -m streamlit run src/ui/agent_chat.py
scripts.dev:flights-mcp: node scripts/dev.mjs flight -- python -m src.mcp_servers.flights --transport stdio
scripts.dev:payments-mcp: node scripts/dev.mjs payment -- python -m src.mcp_servers.payments --transport stdio
scripts.dev:intake: node scripts/dev.mjs intake -- python -m uvicorn src.agent_services.intake.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8011
scripts.dev:orchestrator: node scripts/dev.mjs orchestrator -- python -m uvicorn src.agent_services.orchestrator.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8012
